answer: The admission bond is time locked for 19 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in quill, expire in ridge, and yarrow lists each expiry. Someone running 12 aliases as a result needs 62 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2685 identities would post 4555 proofs and burn roughly 29 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
